requirement_snapshot.name: Tasks List
requirement_snapshot.description: Display a tasks area on the home page with the heading "Tasks" listing tasks from the database via a GET /api/tasks endpoint. Each task row shows its title. An empty state says "No tasks yet." when the table has no rows.

interfaces.name: App
interfaces.responsibility: Express app entry that hosts the built frontend and registers the /api/tasks router additively beside /api/health.
interfaces.specification: Imports tasksRouter and must register app.use('/api/tasks', tasksRouter) before static/SPA fallback; existing lines untouched.
interfaces.test_focus: GET /api/tasks returns 200 JSON with tasks after seed.

interfaces.name: TasksTable
interfaces.responsibility: Defines the tasks table idempotently during database initialization so the list endpoint has a real persisted source.
interfaces.specification: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))).
interfaces.test_focus: Schema exists after initializeDatabase(); rows insertable with title.

interfaces.name: SeedDb
interfaces.responsibility: Deterministic idempotent bootstrap of two tasks so the home page lists database titles on a fresh runtime.
interfaces.specification: seedDatabase() runs INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tasks (id, title) VALUES (1, 'Finish the landing page'), (2, 'Schedule team sync') inside a transaction.
interfaces.test_focus: Seeding twice leaves exactly the two deterministic rows.

interfaces.name: Tasks
interfaces.responsibility: Express router for GET /api/tasks returning the task list fetched through the service layer.
interfaces.specification: GET / -> 200 { tasks: [{ id, title, created_at }] }; failures forwarded via next(error).
interfaces.test_focus: Supertest GET /api/tasks returns seeded titles in order.

interfaces.name: Tasks
interfaces.responsibility: Frontend API client calling GET /api/tasks and returning the tasks array.
interfaces.specification: fetchTasks(): Promise<TaskItem[]> via apiClient.get('/tasks'), resolving data.tasks where TaskItem = { id: number; title: string }.
interfaces.test_focus: Mocked axios resolves { tasks } and fetchTasks returns titles.

interfaces.name: Tasks
interfaces.responsibility: Frontend API client calling GET /api/tasks and returning the tasks array.
interfaces.specification: fetchTasks(): Promise<TaskItem[]> via apiClient.get('/tasks'), resolving data.tasks where TaskItem = { id: number; title: string }.
interfaces.test_focus: Mocked axios resolves { tasks } and fetchTasks returns titles.

interfaces.name: TasksSection
interfaces.responsibility: Home page tasks area rendering the Tasks heading, per-row titles, and the empty state from the hook.
interfaces.specification: Heading text exactly 'Tasks'; each row shows its title; when no rows and not loading, exact text 'No tasks yet.'; loading status and error role=alert states present.
interfaces.test_focus: getByRole heading 'Tasks'; rows render titles; empty table shows 'No tasks yet.'

interfaces.name: useTasks
interfaces.responsibility: Hook owning the fetch lifecycle for the tasks area: loading, success, and error state.
interfaces.specification: useTasks(): TasksState { tasks: TaskItem[]; loading: boolean; error: string | null } fetching via fetchTasks() on mount.
interfaces.test_focus: Render-hook test: resolves tasks, rejects to error, no double fetch.

interfaces.name: HomePage
interfaces.responsibility: Home page shell (parent-owned route entry) extended additively to mount the tasks area.
interfaces.specification: Renders <TasksSection /> inside the existing max-w-7xl container; existing layout untouched.
interfaces.test_focus: Home page render shows TasksSection content.

interfaces.name: ListTasksService
interfaces.responsibility: Service reading all task rows from the tasks table ordered by id for the API layer.
interfaces.specification: listTasks(): Promise<Array<{id,title,created_at}>> via db_runtime all() over 'SELECT id, title, created_at FROM tasks ORDER BY id ASC'.
interfaces.test_focus: Returns rows matching seeded titles; empty array for empty table.

interfaces.name: DbRuntime
interfaces.responsibility: Reused shared SQLite query helpers (run/get/all/exec/withTransaction) powering task reads and seeding.
interfaces.specification: exports run/get/all/exec/withTransaction over the initialized database handle.
interfaces.test_focus: Queries against isolated harness DB return seeded rows.

interfaces.name: SharedApiClient
interfaces.responsibility: Reused shared axios instance with baseURL /api used by the tasks client.
interfaces.specification: default export axios instance: baseURL '/api', timeout 5000, JSON content type.
interfaces.test_focus: fetchTasks targets '/tasks' on the shared client.
